column1: Who can bring OTHER big names into the effort. Companion to the Reach Ranking sheet — paste columns D-F in there to fold connectivity into that composite.
⚠️ ESTIMATES. CONNECT is 1-10: convening power x recruitment track record x structural position x WILLINGNESS TO SPEND SOCIAL CAPITAL.
That last factor decides it. Michael Jordan knows everyone and will ask no one (3). Michael Rubin will make the call today (10).
⭐ SORTED BY LEVERAGE = CONNECT x AVAIL. Sort by CONNECT alone to see raw network; by LEVERAGE to see who is actually gettable.
Collective members (2HYPE, AMP, Barstool, Sidemen) carry a floor of 7 — signing one brings the crew at near-zero marginal cost.
